name: Safina Tani Crusch
original_name: サフィーナ・ターニ・クルシュ
source:
"I don't want to fight with elder sister... Why is this happening?"

The daughter and second princess of Tamanna. She's more princess-like than Farasha, and her friendly nature has made her more popular with the masses. Yearns for Farasha, but understands that her position will not permit her. She truthfully says that she has no intention of competing with her elder stepsister, but those around her, including her mother, don't approve.
